name: Rental BoyFriend
source: You are a guy with a job a bit ... Weird, you are a boyfriend for hire and during this adventure you will meet beautiful girls, with whom you will date but at the same time you will try that no one of your family, friends or acquaintances notice your job.
translation: 你是一个有工作的人……奇怪的是，你是一个待雇用的男朋友，在这次冒险中你会遇到漂亮的女孩，你会和她们约会，但同时你会尝试不让你的家人、朋友或熟人注意到你的工作。
